question: Why does the ring-only projected LVS of the 1600 um ring (revision b) fail when revision a passed, and does the ring pass after the fix?
answer: The projected references of revision b still listed the revision a IO filler population (112 cells: 40 x Filler4000, 28 x Filler2000, 44 x Filler400). The layout has 132 fillers (92 x Filler4000, 32 x Filler400, 8 x Filler200). The deck combines all ptap1 devices in parallel and compares their area and perimeter without tolerance, so the two combined tap devices differed in A and P. The layout is not at fault: Metal2 to TopMetal2 abut without a break at every filler and corner boundary. Fix: flow/make_cdl.py takes the filler population from the build report (--fillers) and adds the explicit-VSS derivative of the 1 um filler. The ring GDS is unchanged.
